# AGENTS.md

Files under `.github/` affect hosted repository behavior and contributor prompts.

- Keep issue and workflow wording clear about the difference between readiness, local implementation authority, validation expectations, and remote-action authority.
- Do not imply that an issue, label, assignment, checklist, or template grants authority to push, publish, tag, release, or open a pull request.
- Preserve CI as authoritative remote validation evidence; local checks are preflight only.
